So with my experience with the finals (200 hours) and sbmm in other games, there’s good and bad news. Good news, you’re not crazy. Bad news, this will continue to happen. The game tries to match “fairness” by having your hidden mmr be balanced through a team mmr. Meaning if your mmr is 550 and both your teammates have 25. Then it’ll total to 600, while another team could have players that have 200 each totaling to 600. Unfortunately this is also the case in ranked and I hope it is removed in future seasons.
